usedFor: When a person is removed in Intercom, files you keep for them in Dropbox can go too. Intercom holds the contacts and conversations; “Delete File or Folder” cleans up the matching documents in Dropbox.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Is Deleted” in Intercom, then “Delete File or Folder” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: A deleted contact is the one Intercom event that clearly means their files should go as well, so cleanup follows the person instead of a ticket state.

watchOut: “Delete File or Folder” removes a folder and everything inside it. Point it at the exact location for one contact and test on a throwaway folder first.
